references.description: The Bible references the text in the picture names, in the order the page has them, each once per place it is printed. Empty when the picture names none.

printed.description: The reference as the page prints it, without the translation tag or the brackets: 'Gen. 1:28', 'Rom 8:28-30', '1 John 1:1'.

ref.description: The reference in OSIS form: the book's OSIS code, a dot, the chapter, and a dot and the verse when the page gives one ('Gen.1.28', 'Rom.8.28', '1John.1.1', 'Ps.23'). A range or a list keeps its first verse here and is whole in `printed`.
